decisions_log.decision: Unified project identity: Workspace is a single-user PWA for personal task/schedule management replacing Notion
decisions_log.reason: Clarifies scope and prevents feature creep; single user means no auth complexity in v1
decisions_log.alternatives_considered: Multi-user SaaS (rejected for scope); desktop-only app (rejected for PWA offline goals)

decisions_log.decision: MongoDB for persistence (not SQLite or Firestore)
decisions_log.reason: Document model maps naturally to Workspace entities (Threads, Tasks, Goals); Atlas provides free tier; Mongoose provides TypeScript support
decisions_log.alternatives_considered: SQLite (wrong data model), PostgreSQL (overkill for single user), Firestore (PRD specified MongoDB)

decisions_log.decision: Express + Node.js backend (not Next.js API Routes)
decisions_log.reason: Clear separation of frontend/backend; simpler deployment options (Vercel serverless or Render/Railway); explicit API routing
decisions_log.alternatives_considered: Next.js full-stack (adds complexity for SPA frontend needs)

decisions_log.decision: Vercel or Render/Railway for hosting (deferred final choice to Benedict)
decisions_log.reason: Both support the stack; Vercel cheaper/simpler, Render/Railway lower latency for persistent backend
decisions_log.alternatives_considered: Self-hosted (adds ops burden for single user); fly.io (less familiar)

decisions_log.decision: Grid generation as core algorithm (separate service, not inline)
decisions_log.reason: Grid logic is complex enough to warrant unit testing; separation allows regeneration triggered from multiple endpoints
decisions_log.alternatives_considered: Inline in task creation (harder to test and regenerate)

decisions_log.reason: Granular phases allow incremental validation; each phase has clear acceptance criteria; allows parallel work on frontend/backend after Phase 2
decisions_log.alternatives_considered: Monolithic waterfall (higher risk of rework); smaller phases (false sense of progress)

decisions_log.decision: Use lime green primary color (#B4E700 = HSL 72 98% 74%) matching benedictisaac_ project
decisions_log.reason: Consistency with reference UI; vibrant, modern appearance; excellent contrast in light/dark modes

decisions_log.decision: Space Grotesk font family (sans-serif, modern, geometric)
decisions_log.reason: Consistent with reference project; professional yet contemporary feel

decisions_log.decision: Sidebar navigation (fixed on desktop, collapsible on mobile)
decisions_log.reason: Improved UX; clear view hierarchy; common pattern in productivity apps
decisions_log.alternatives_considered: Top navigation only (less real estate), hamburger menu only (mobile-first)

decisions_log.decision: Time blocks: Morning / Afternoon / Evening instead of specific times
decisions_log.reason: Flexibility for user's work patterns; avoids timezone complications in UI

decisions_log.decision: Grid algorithm as separate service (not inline in tasks route)
decisions_log.reason: Testability, reusability, separation of concerns, easy to regenerate

decisions_log.decision: Auto-gen tasks stored in database (not computed on-the-fly)
decisions_log.reason: Allows user manual overrides to persist; regeneration is a deliberate action
decisions_log.alternatives_considered: Computed on GET /api/grid (can't preserve manual edits)
